dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains the results of a spatial plant-soil feedback experiment. It contains plant biomass during the conditioning and test phases of the experiment for the different treatments as well as data on the abiotic conditions in the conditioned soils at the end of the conditioning phase.

value: Results of experiment inclduing plant biomass data and measured abiotic variables.

files.description: #All biomass data from phase 2 in spatial PSF experiment per gridcell, variables are: # Pot: phase to unique pot identifier (1-329) # Space: spatial design of the pot (uniform, coarse grain, fine grain) # MS: Was the soil of the whole phase 2 pot conditioned in phase 1 by a monoculture? (yes/no) # MV: Was the Phase 2 vegetation a monoculture? (yes/no) # Soil: the soil treatment (which plant conditioned the soil in phase 1) # Plant: the plant species used in the test phase (Phase 2) # Soil.rep: Phase 1 soils of each type were mixed in 3 replicate sets, this is the identifier # Cell: within pot cell identifier (1-16 for each pot) # Xcoord: x-coordinate of the cell within the pot (1-4), apply only within pot! # Ycoord, same in Y direction # SCi: Soil treatment (as for Soil) applied to the specific cell # PCi: test plant species growing in the specific cell # NPCi: number of surviving test plants at final harvest in that specific cell # AGBCi: aboveground dry biomass of the test plant species in that cell (g) # BGBCi: same belowground
files.label: P2 data per cell.csv

dataFile.description: #All biomass data from phase 2 in spatial PSF experiment per gridcell, variables are: # Pot: phase to unique pot identifier (1-329) # Space: spatial design of the pot (uniform, coarse grain, fine grain) # MS: Was the soil of the whole phase 2 pot conditioned in phase 1 by a monoculture? (yes/no) # MV: Was the Phase 2 vegetation a monoculture? (yes/no) # Soil: the soil treatment (which plant conditioned the soil in phase 1) # Plant: the plant species used in the test phase (Phase 2) # Soil.rep: Phase 1 soils of each type were mixed in 3 replicate sets, this is the identifier # Cell: within pot cell identifier (1-16 for each pot) # Xcoord: x-coordinate of the cell within the pot (1-4), apply only within pot! # Ycoord, same in Y direction # SCi: Soil treatment (as for Soil) applied to the specific cell # PCi: test plant species growing in the specific cell # NPCi: number of surviving test plants at final harvest in that specific cell # AGBCi: aboveground dry biomass of the test plant species in that cell (g) # BGBCi: same belowground

files.description: # File contains the following collumns: # Pot#  =  Phase II pot number (unique identifier) # Space =  Spatial design of the pot's soil (levels: Uniform, coarse and fine) # MS: Was the soil of the whole phase 2 pot conditioned in phase 1 by a monoculture? (yes/no) # MV: Was the Phase 2 vegetation a monoculture? (yes/no) # Soil  =  P1 soil used in the pot (levels: 6 monocultures, 2 mixes) # Plant =  Plant species planted in the pot (levels: 6 monocultures, 3 mixes) # NoPlants = Number of target species plants harvested from the pot # PotAGB   = Total aboveground plant biomass harvested from the pot (g/pot) # IndAGB   = PotAGB/NoPlants (g/ind) # mean_AGBC = mean aboveground biomass of the cells of that pot (g/cell) # SD_AGBC   = standard deviation of aboveground biomass of the cells of that pot (g/cell) # mean_BGBC = mean belowground biomass of the cells of that pot (g/cell) - for pot with uniform spatial design this is based on 8 soil cores rather than 16 # SD_BGBC   = standard deviation of belowground biomass of the cells of that pot (g/cell) - for pot with uniform spatial design this is based on 8 soil cores rather than 16 # PotBGB    = Calculated total pot root biomass: mean_BGBC * 16 cells (g/pot) # IndBGB    = PotBGB/NoPlants (g/ind) # TotalPB   = Calculated total pot biomass: PotAGB + PotBGB  (g/pot), NB. This is an underestimate, because due to the use of root corers the estimate of root biomass is an underestimate # RSratio   = Root:shoot ratio, estimated as PotBGB/PotAGB - makes little sense in plant mixtures!!!!
files.label: P2 Pot level.csv

This is an underestimate, because due to the use of root corers the estimate of root biomass is an underestimate # RSratio   = Root:shoot ratio, estimated as PotBGB/PotAGB - makes little sense in plant mixtures!!!!
